cues: Because with a clause, because of with a noun.
Although with a clause, in spite of with a noun.
Beside means next to; besides means in addition to.
So with an adjective, such with a noun.
Too means more than is acceptable: too hot to drink.
And since marks a point of time, for a length of time.
